components.css: .ds-card{display:block;background:var(--surface);color:var(--foreground);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;transition:transform 200ms ease-out,border-color 200ms}.ds-card article{padding:26px}.ds-card span,.ds-card p{color:var(--secondary);font:13px/1.85 Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-card h3{font:600 20px/1.4 Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--border-strong)}.ds-card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-card{transition:none}.ds-card:hover{transform:none}}

narrative.overview: An editorial research notebook after dark: ink-blue surfaces, generous typography, soft mint interaction and a geometric network illustration. Premium restraint keeps real research readable. Homepage mode is Experience; articles are Read; admin, editor and login are Operate.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial hierarchy and generous negative space.
Ink surfaces, mint actions and restrained cyan illustration detail.
Evidence before claims; accessible interaction before decoration.

rules.name: The Readable Evidence Rule
rules.body: Body and metadata target at least 4.5:1 contrast. Selection reverses ink and mint. Carets and consent checkboxes use mint.

dos: Do use database records for research, categories and credentials.
Do preserve keyboard focus, semantic links, readable text contrast and reduced motion.
Do keep article text at a comfortable 75ch maximum.
donts: Don't invent research, accomplishments, availability or monitoring telemetry.
Don't add animation dependencies or make content wait for JavaScript entrance effects.
Don't treat decorative borders as a substitute for control focus.
